mentions.name: New Yokosuka
mentions.description: An unofficial browser-based Shenmue MMO experience based on the 1999 Sega Dreamcast game, featuring basic world exploration, forklift shenanigans, basic dialogue systems, and a combat system test, with an upcoming update adding all cutscenes and story progression adapted to fit an MMO context.
mentions.source_excerpt: https://www.newyokosuka.com/ - an unofficial Shenmue MMO experience. Based on the 1999 Sega Dreamcast game Shenmue, it's playable entirely in your browser!
